meta.name: footage-cutlist
meta.description: Watch a brand's own product footage (screen recording, product film), pick the moment that proves each line with the user, and render those picks as a product layer — free, local. survey.py turns footage into timestamped contact sheets + scene cuts + motion so the agent can actually look at it; the agent writes a cut list (beat → source window + framing); preview.py draws it as a review sheet the user corrects round by round; cut.py renders the approved list into a silent 1080x1920 layer with the creator's area left as a plate. Also frames footage as a filmed screen (keystone, bezel, handheld drift) with dissolves between beats, and takes still screenshots as sources. Use for any format that shows real product footage beside, between or instead of a creator (split-screen, screen inserts, walkthroughs).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从产品录屏里挑出能证明每句文案的瞬间,拼成可直接用的产品画面层
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有大量产品录屏,却挑不出能和口播对齐的画面。
copy.tagline_en: Pick proof moments from product footage and render a silent product layer
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have hours of product footage and need proof shots that match your voiceover.

howto.what: Claude 会先看完你的产品录屏或产品片，切出带时间戳的缩略图、场景切换与静止片段，逐句和你确认每句台词配哪段画面，形成剪辑清单；经你确认后渲染成无声 1080x1920 产品层，创作者区域留空。
howto.when: 当你要做分屏、屏幕插入或产品走查等需要展示真实产品录像的视频时触发。
